blocks.text: 消失的熱情 冷淡的溫存
blocks.spelling: siau-sit ê lé-tsîng  líng-tām ê un-tshûn

blocks.text: 我惦黑暗的空氣中 走找最後的可能
blocks.spelling: guá tiām oo-àm ê khong-khì tiong tsáu-tshuē tsuè-āu ê khó-lîng

blocks.text: 吵鬧的聲音 無聊的劇情
blocks.spelling: tshá-nāu ê siann-im  bô-liâu ê kio̍k-tsîng

blocks.text: 一段感情漸漸變化 事到如今我才知樣
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t tuānn kám-tsîng tsiām tsiām  piàn-huà sū kàu lû-kim guá tsiah tsai-iánn

blocks.text: 是不是愛到無命不知驚 撕開傷痕才知痛
blocks.spelling: sī m̄ sī ài kàu bô-miā m̄ tsai kiann  liah-khui siong-hûn tsiah tsai thiànn

blocks.text: 寫滿溫柔的笑容 是美麗的背叛
blocks.spelling: siá muá un-jiû ê tshiò-iông  sī bí-lē ê puē-puān

blocks.text: 是不是凍過霜雪不知寒 失去了後才知輸贏
blocks.spelling: sī m̄ sī tàng kuè sng-seh m̄ tsai kuânn  sit-khì liáu-āu tsiah tsai su-iânn

blocks.text: 原來今生的孤單 直咱初見面的時 就已經註定
blocks.spelling: guân-lâi kim-sing ê koo-tuann  ti̍t lán tshoo kìnn-bīn ê sî  tō í-king tsù-tiānn
